body.resource_hint: With positive adjoint *=kappa sharp kappa, write A=A_even+A_odd under alpha(A)=kappa A kappa. Trace invariance kills the cross terms and gives Tr(A^sharp A)=||A_even||_2^2-||A_odd||_2^2. The canonical normal CP expectation E_kappa=(1+alpha)/2 retains A_even, so it preserves this quadratic functional iff A_odd=0 under a faithful Hilbert trace. For the pointer theorem, V, U_g, P_ground and P_click are all fixed by total kappa. Hence A_g=P_click U_g P_ground is fixed, A_g^sharp=A_g*, and its public generalized Born effect equals the ordinary positive click effect sin^2(g|K|). The selected q8 tangent therefore has the same value in both prescriptions, while a general Eq. (19) remainder cannot be erased this way unless already fixed.
